an6.95:1.3: Abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paccāgantuṃ, abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paccāgantuṃ, abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sayaṃkatañ ca paraṃkatañ ca sukhadukkhaṃ paccāgantuṃ, abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo asayaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paccāgantuṃ, abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paccāgantuṃ, abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo asayaṃkārañ ca aparaṃkārañ ca adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paccāgantuṃ.
an6.95:1.5: Tathā hi 'ssa bhikkhave diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa hetu ca sudiṭṭho, hetusamuppannā ca dhammā.
an6.95:1.6: Imāni kho bhikkhave cha abhabbaṭṭhānānī ti.
